$doc: §23.6 mixed. No enemy on purpose: a stochastic observer cannot yet target a physical unit (F-10) and a physical weapon cannot hit a stochastic unit before the handover (ST-5, C-7), so a fight would judge the engine, not the routing. CompanyAttack gives the assault to the first platoon on its roster, the base of fire to the second and holds the third: the stochastic platoon is created first so the physical play PlatoonAttack is not exercised here (the cc-battalion scenarios are its rails) - the physical platoons' plays are pinned as measured.

expect.name: the stochastic platoon is ordered by KIND: the generic Attack play
the 1st physical platoon is the base of fire (its own physical play)
the 2nd physical platoon holds (its own physical play)
the stochastic platoon is never given a physical play
a physical platoon is never given a stochastic play
the objective is held (25 men inside)
